articles.title: Caught on CCTV: Dog Beaten 26 Times in 21 Seconds in Rajkot, Outrage Erupts
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rajkot (Gujarat): A shocking case of animal cruelty has surfaced from Rajkot, where a dog was allegedly brutally beaten by two men, triggering widespread outrage after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

body.html:
Rajkot (Gujarat): A shocking case of animal cruelty has surfaced from Rajkot, where a dog was allegedly brutally beaten by two men, triggering widespread outrage after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place near Madhapar Chokdi and Kalyan Park area on Friday. In the footage, the dog is seen tied outside a house while two men mercilessly thrash it with sticks and pipes. Reports claim the animal was struck nearly 26 times within seconds, leaving it severely injured.

According to local sources, the accused have been identified as a father-son duo. The dog, which had reportedly been cared for by a local resident for over two years, was tied near the house when the attack took place. It is alleged that the men were angered by the dog’s barking.

During the assault, two women rushed to the spot and attempted to intervene, trying to snatch the sticks from the attackers, after which the assault stopped. The dog was later seen lying injured on the ground.

Following the incident, a complaint was filed, and an FIR has been registered at the concerned police station. The injured dog is currently under treatment and is said to be in stable condition.

The video has sparked massive outrage online, with citizens and animal welfare groups demanding strict action against the accused. Actor and former MP Mimi Chakraborty also reacted strongly, expressing anguish over the incident and calling for accountability.

Authorities have initiated an investigation, and further action is expected based on the findings.

#Rajkot #Gujarat #AnimalCruelty #ViralVideo #JusticeForAnimals

articles.title: Horror in Faridabad: Mother Throws 18-Month-Old Daughter into Drain, Poverty Cited as Motive
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Faridabad (Haryana): In a deeply disturbing incident, a woman has been arrested for allegedly killing her 18-month-old daughter by throwing her into a drain in the Palla area of Faridabad.

body.html:
Faridabad (Haryana): In a deeply disturbing incident, a woman has been arrested for allegedly killing her 18-month-old daughter by throwing her into a drain in the Palla area of Faridabad.

The accused, identified as Neelam, originally from Madhubani in Bihar, was taken into custody after CCTV footage reportedly showed her carrying the child near the drain and returning alone. During police interrogation, she allegedly confessed to the crime.

The incident took place on April 23 near Dheeraj Nagar, where two schoolchildren first spotted the infant’s body stuck in an iron mesh along a drain, locally known as Budhiya Nala. They alerted nearby residents, following which police reached the spot and recovered the body.

The body was sent for postmortem, which confirmed that the child died due to drowning.

According to police, Neelam lived in Faridabad with her husband, who works in a private firm. During questioning, she reportedly stated that the deceased was the youngest of her six daughters and cited extreme financial hardship as the reason behind her actions.

Police spokesperson Yashpal Singh confirmed that the accused is in custody and that further investigation is underway to establish all circumstances surrounding the incident.

The case has shocked the local community and raised serious concerns over the impact of poverty and family pressures on vulnerable households.

Authorities are continuing their probe and have urged the public to come forward with any relevant information.

#Faridabad #Haryana #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #ChildSafety

articles.title: Caught on Camera: Street Dog Attacked with Machete in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru (Karnataka): A shocking case of animal cruelty has come to light from the KR Puram area, where a street dog was allegedly attacked with a machete in broad daylight, triggering widespread outrage after CCTV footage surfaced online.

body.html:
Bengaluru (Karnataka): A shocking case of animal cruelty has come to light from the KR Puram area, where a street dog was allegedly attacked with a machete in broad daylight, triggering widespread outrage after CCTV footage surfaced online.

According to reports, the incident occurred around 8:30 am on Saturday within the limits of KR Puram police station. A tender coconut vendor is alleged to have attacked the stray dog with a machete in full public view.

Preliminary information suggests that the accused claimed the dog was causing disturbances in the area. The animal was reportedly associated with a senior citizen in the locality. Acting in anger, the vendor allegedly assaulted the dog, inflicting a deep wound on its back.

Following the incident, local residents intervened and rescued the injured dog, which is currently undergoing treatment. Veterinarians have confirmed that the animal sustained serious injuries and remains in pain.

Based on a complaint filed by a resident, an FIR has been registered at KR Puram Police Station. Police have launched an investigation, are examining CCTV footage, and are working to trace and arrest the accuse.

The incident has drawn strong condemnation from residents and animal welfare groups, who have demanded strict action against those responsible.

#Bengaluru #AnimalCruelty #KRPuram #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: ‘Shut Up’ Row in Hardoi School: Principal Accused of Abuse, Threatening Student’s Expulsion Over
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hardoi (Uttar Pradesh): A controversy has erupted at a private school in Hardoi after its principal was accused of misbehaving with a parent, with a video of the incident going viral on social media.

body.html:
Hardoi (Uttar Pradesh): A controversy has erupted at a private school in Hardoi after its principal was accused of misbehaving with a parent, with a video of the incident going viral on social media.

According to reports, the incident took place at New Sunbeam School, where principal Mamta Mishra allegedly got into a heated argument with Neelam Verma, mother of a UKG student. The dispute reportedly began after the parent purchased notebooks from an outside shop instead of the school’s recommended vendor.

In the viral video, the principal is seen repeatedly shouting “shut up”—reportedly around ten times within a minute—and asking the parent to “get lost.” She also allegedly threatened to remove the child’s name from the school register and asked the parent to immediately withdraw the student.

The parent has further alleged that the principal used abusive and derogatory language, including terms such as “bloody fool,” “swine,” and “gawar.”

Following the incident, Neelam Verma filed a formal complaint with the District Magistrate, seeking strict action against the principal.

The episode has triggered widespread criticism online, raising concerns over the conduct of private educational institutions, alleged “commission-based” practices, and their treatment of parents despite charging high fees.

Authorities from the district administration and the Education Department are expected to review the matter. Further action will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

#Hardoi #UPNews #SchoolControversy #ViralVideo #EducationSystem

articles.title: Reel Gone Wrong: Youth Gets Head Stuck in Metal Can, Risky Rescue in Rajasthan Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Alwar (Rajasthan): A social media stunt turned dangerous for a youth in Rajasthan’s Alwar district after his head got stuck inside a metal milk can, triggering a tense rescue operation. The incident occurred in Madhogarh village under the Akbarpur police station area.

body.html:
Alwar (Rajasthan): A social media stunt turned dangerous for a youth in Rajasthan’s Alwar district after his head got stuck inside a metal milk can, triggering a tense rescue operation.

The incident occurred in Madhogarh village under the Akbarpur police station area. The youth, identified as Kaluram, was reportedly on his way to sell wheat when he placed a 15-litre metal milk can over his head, allegedly to beat the heat and record a reel. However, the container got tightly lodged, leaving him trapped.

According to local sources, the can weighed nearly 10 kilograms, making the situation more difficult. Kaluram initially tried to remove it himself but failed. As panic grew, he alerted nearby villagers, who rushed to help.

With no immediate solution, locals took him to a nearby hardware shop, where a grinder machine was used to carefully cut open the metal can. The rescue was carried out with extreme caution, as any mistake could have caused serious injury. Eyewitnesses said the youth appeared visibly shaken during the ordeal.

A video of the rescue, filmed by onlookers, has gone viral on social media, drawing widespread attention and raising concerns over the risks of performing dangerous stunts for online content.

Local representatives confirmed the details of the incident. Fortunately, Kaluram was rescued safely without major injuries.

#Rajasthan #Alwar #ViralVideo #SocialMediaStunt #BreakingNews

articles.title: Road Rage Horror in Indore: Man Threatens Family, Terrifies Children After Minor Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): A disturbing case of road rage has surfaced from Indore, where a minor vehicle collision allegedly escalated into a tense standoff, leaving a family and their children terrified.

body.html:
Indore (Madhya Pradesh): A disturbing case of road rage has surfaced from Indore, where a minor vehicle collision allegedly escalated into a tense standoff, leaving a family and their children terrified.

According to reports, the incident occurred after a small accident between two vehicles. Following the collision, one of the drivers became aggressive and stood in front of the family’s car holding a stick.

A video of the incident, now widely circulating on social media, shows the family pleading with the man to stop. The parents can be heard repeatedly saying, “Bhaiya, car mein bacche hain… mat kijiye,” as they tried to calm the situation.

Despite the pleas, the man allegedly continued to behave aggressively, gesturing to break the car window and forcing the driver to roll it down. The children and a woman inside the vehicle appeared visibly frightened during the confrontation.

The victims alleged that instead of resolving the issue through legal means, such as insurance or compensation, the accused resorted to threats and intimidation.

The incident has sparked concern over rising road rage cases and public safety. Experts emphasise that disputes arising from minor accidents should be handled through lawful procedures rather than violence.

Police are expected to take cognisance of the viral video and initiate an investigation based on the complaint.

#Indore #RoadRage #ViralVideo #PublicSafety #BreakingNews

articles.title: Accused in Rape & Forced Conversion Case Escapes from Varanasi Police Station, Massive Manhun
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh): A man accused of rape and forcing a woman to convert her religion allegedly escaped from the Kotwali police station, triggering a major police search operation.

body.html:
Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh): A man accused of rape and forcing a woman to convert her religion allegedly escaped from the Kotwali police station, triggering a major police search operation.

The accused, identified as Aftab Ansari alias Amit, a resident of Rasulpur (Harhua, Baragaon), had been taken into custody on Friday following a complaint filed by the victim. However, he managed to flee from the police station around 7 pm while legal formalities, including the FIR registration, were underway.

According to the victim, she met the accused in 2024 while working in catering at wedding events. He allegedly introduced himself as “Amit” and promised her job opportunities. The two later developed a relationship, during which he allegedly took her to hotels multiple times and sexually exploited her.

The woman further alleged that the accused concealed his identity and religion, and married her on March 25, 2025, as per Hindu rituals at a temple in Chowkaghat. She claimed her family spent around ₹2 lakh on the marriage.

After the wedding, she was taken to a rented house in Lahartara instead of his family home. She alleged that his real identity came to light later, following which he began pressuring her to convert. The woman also accused him and his family members of assault, threats, and confinement.

In her complaint, she further alleged that she was kept confined for about a month and sexually assaulted, including by the accused’s brother. She also claimed she was threatened with being trafficked.

Based on the complaint, police initiated action and took the accused into custody. However, he reportedly escaped from the Kotwali police station during the process.

DCP Kashi Zone Gaurav Bansal confirmed that the accused fled after learning about the case. Police teams have been deployed, and raids are underway to trace and arrest him.

Further investigation into the allegations is ongoing.

#Varanasi #UPPolice #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #Manhunt

articles.title: Panic at Mekedatu: Wild Elephant Charges at Tourists in Cauvery River, Woman Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kanakapura (Karnataka): A tense situation unfolded near Mekedatu in the Sangama forest area after a wild elephant suddenly charged at tourists playing in the Cauvery river on Friday (24 April 2026) evening.

body.html:
Kanakapura (Karnataka): A tense situation unfolded near Mekedatu in the Sangama forest area after a wild elephant suddenly charged at tourists playing in the Cauvery river on Friday (24 April 2026) evening.

According to reports, hundreds of visitors were present at the popular tourist spot when a lone tusker emerged from the forest, reportedly to drink water. The animal suddenly charged towards the crowd, triggering panic as tourists ran for safety.

During the chaos, a woman was attacked and sustained minor injuries. She was later admitted to a nearby hospital for treatment.

Eyewitnesses said the elephant crossed the river after the attack and retreated back into the forest. The entire incident was captured on a mobile phone by a local and is now circulating online.

Forest officials reached the spot and conducted an inspection following the incident. Locals have demanded better safety measures, including deployment of forest personnel at the site, to prevent such incidents in the future.

Authorities are monitoring the situation to ensure the safety of visitors in the area.

#Karnataka #Mekedatu #ElephantAttack #WildlifeConflict #BreakingNews

articles.title: Cake Smear Turns Deadly: 3 Shot Dead at Birthday Party in UP’s Khurja, Accused on the Run
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bulandshahr (Uttar Pradesh): A birthday celebration turned into a triple murder in Khurja town after a minor dispute reportedly over smearing cake escalated into firing, leaving three people dead. The incident took place late Saturday night at RJS Fitness Gym.

body.html:
Bulandshahr (Uttar Pradesh): A birthday celebration turned into a triple murder in Khurja town after a minor dispute reportedly over smearing cake escalated into firing, leaving three people dead.

The incident took place late Saturday night at RJS Fitness Gym. According to police, the party was hosted by Jeetu Saini, a former BSP city president, on the occasion of his birthday.

During the celebration, a relative of BJP councillor Sanjay Saini allegedly smeared cake on Jeetu’s face as part of a joke, which led to an argument. The dispute quickly escalated, following which the accused, along with his associates, allegedly opened indiscriminate fire.

Three victims—Manish Saini (30), younger brother of the councillor, Akash Saini (19), his nephew, and Amardeep Saini (32), his cousin—died on the spot.

After the firing, the accused reportedly removed the gym’s CCTV DVR in an attempt to destroy evidence and fled from the scene.

Senior police officials, including SP Rural Antariksh Jain and DIG Kalanidhi Naithani, reached the spot with heavy police deployment. Authorities said preliminary inquiry suggests a fight broke out inside the gym before the shooting.

Police have formed multiple teams to track down the accused and are scanning CCTV footage from nearby areas. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem.

The incident has triggered tension in the area, with police maintaining a strong presence to prevent any further escalation.

#Khurja #Bulandshahr #TripleMurder #UPPolice #BreakingNews

articles.title: Aligarh Labourer Dies in Pipeline Work, Family Alleges Forced Entry by JE
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh): A 32-year-old labourer died after being buried in a mudslide while repairing a water pipeline in a 14-foot-deep pit on Railway Road on Saturday afternoon. A video of the incident has also surfaced, showing a large portion of soil collapsing into the pit.

body.html:
Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh): A 32-year-old labourer died after being buried in a mudslide while repairing a water pipeline in a 14-foot-deep pit on Railway Road on Saturday afternoon. A video of the incident has also surfaced, showing a large portion of soil collapsing into the pit.

The deceased, identified as Mahendra, a resident of Jawan, was working on a damaged pipeline when the incident occurred around 2 pm. He was pulled out by co-workers using a JCB and rushed to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

Mahendra’s brother, Rajkumar, alleged serious negligence and accused Junior Engineer (JE) Narendra Singh of forcing the labourers to work despite visible danger. “The soil was cracking from above. I requested him to stop the work, but he abused us and pushed my brother into the pit,” he claimed. The family also alleged that the JE fled the spot after the incident.

Following the death, family members created a ruckus at the hospital and briefly stopped police from taking the body for post-mortem, demanding action against those responsible. The situation was brought under control after police assured action.

According to the family, no safety measures such as helmets or belts were provided at the site. They also alleged that the work was being carried out without a proper tender and labourers were being made to work under pressure, even late at night.

Mahendra is survived by his wife Malti, a 16-year-old son, and an 11-year-old daughter. His wife has demanded strict action against the accused and compensation of ₹50 lakh.

However, Municipal Commissioner Prem Prakash Meena stated that safety arrangements were in place and termed the incident unfortunate. He said a three-member committee has been formed to investigate the matter and will submit a report within three days.

Officials have announced financial assistance of ₹5 lakh for the victim’s family, while further action will depend on the inquiry findings. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has also taken cognisance of the incident and directed officials to ensure support for the bereaved family.

#Aligarh #LabourDeath #Negligence #UPNews #BreakingNews
